## Summary of the last run

The page is largely correct. The main theorem (Freyd–Mitchell) is stated without proof as intended, and the two lemmas (small abelian subcategory, faithful exact functor reflects exactness) are proved correctly. The transfer principle is correctly derived. The Yoneda proposition is correct: the Yoneda embedding into Ab-valued presheaves is fully faithful and left exact (since limits in the functor category are componentwise and hom functors are left exact), but not right exact in general (the example with $\mathbb{Z}\to\mathbb{Z}/2$ is valid). The supplement's historical remarks and the analogy with Cayley/Stone/Yoneda are accurate. The problems and solutions are correct. No genuine logical errors, missing hypotheses, or improper links were found.
